paper.title_en: Many-Anyon Braiding in Non-Abelian Fractional Quantum Hall Effect with Hybrid Monte Carlo Simulation
paper.abstract_en: We use the hybrid Monte Carlo method to efficiently compute the many-anyon non-Abelian braiding matrices for different Moore-Read quasiholes braiding schemes. Using both a traditional two-anyon braiding scheme and a newly proposed braiding scheme based on global rotation, we approximate the non-Abelian characteristic length of Moore-Read quasiholes around $2.8$ times the magnetic length. We also apply this method to braiding schemes involving six anyons and explicitly show that the well-known ``even-odd effect'' can be flipped by tuning electrostatic potentials. This phenomenon emphasizes the importance of accounting for all anyons within a non-Abelian system, even if the braiding involves only several anyons locally. Our results are relevant to the experimental realization of non-Abelian physics in fractional quantum Hall and other analogous systems, including the fast-growing field of fractional quantum anomalous Hall states in moiré materials.
